description: Search companies by name (`q`). Returns up to 10 matches with the company name, logo URL, domain, industry, size, location and LinkedIn URL; pass the LinkedIn URL to get_company_profile for the full profile. The result has the v3 answer in `data`, the credits charged for the call in `creditCost` and the `requestId` to quote to support. Fields with no value (null, empty lists, empty objects, empty text) are left out of `data`; for an optional section, a missing field means it found nothing or was not asked for. An answer is never longer than 24,000 bytes: if the full answer is longer, `data` keeps every field and every list that fits, and each list it leaves out is named in `more` with its number of items, its approximate size, its number of pages and a `cursor` for get_more. A list that is in `data` is always complete. Reading a page with get_more is a new lookup and is charged.
name: search_companies
title: Search Companies
